reviews.title: App has Become Frustrating Due to Ads
reviews.text:
App Title: We Muslim Prayer App Rating: 1 Star
This app has become absolutely terrible over the last 6 months. It feels like the developers have turned it into nothing but an ad-watching machine.
Now, you can’t view almost anything without being forced to watch 10-15 second ads. Even worse, if you accidentally open the app in the mosque, these ads sometimes play at full volume with completely inappropriate content — it’s extremely embarrassing and disrespectful during prayer time.
This app was originally created to help Muslims on Allah’s path — giving accurate prayer times, mosque locations, Hadiths, and peace of mind. Now it’s become a frustrating experience just to use basic features. You can’t even see the full day’s prayer timings without subscribing. The greed is really disappointing.
Earlier, the subscription option was acceptable because the app was still usable without constant interruptions. But now the ads are nonstop and the experience has been ruined.
If you want people to keep downloading and using your app, stop making it so painful. Make people’s lives easier instead of harder. At this rate, the flood of negative reviews will drive users away.
Please remove or greatly reduce these intrusive ads. Hoping the developers actually read this and respond.
